name: Onee-chan Eroero Chuuihou ~Aieki no Daikouzui~
original_name: お姉ちゃんエロエロ注意報～愛液の大洪水～
source:
* Famed beautiful sister has a brother complex! *

The protagonist's big sister was smart and gorgeous - a local legend of beauty.
But this girl, she had a dirty indulgence within the private walls of her home.
She didn't care how wrong it was!
She loved to f*ck her little brother!

Live the extreme incest days of a deeply satisfying sibling! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE078893.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
＊远近闻名的美女姐姐竟有严重恋弟情结！＊

主角的姐姐聪明又美丽，是当地公认的传奇美人。
然而关起家门，她却沉溺于肮脏的享乐。
她根本不在乎这种关系有多么不伦！
她最爱与亲弟弟做爱！

体验这对彼此满足的姐弟极端乱伦的每一天！

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE078893.html]DLsite English[/url]]
